༄༅/ /nag sbyor ha la nag po'i dmigs pa bco lnga pa bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /nag sbyor ha la nag po'i dmigs pa bco lnga pa bzhugs so/ /

e ma hoḥ skye med ngang las ma g.yos kyang*/ /'gags med shugs 'byung lhun gyis grub/ /gnas med snyigs ma'i 'gro ba 'dren/ /mtha' bral lab sgron zhabs la 'dud/ /snyan brgyud don gyi gdams pa 'di/ /pha mdo don zhal nas gsungs pa bzhin/ /yum chen ṭāk+ki'i bka' brgyud rnams/ /bdag la byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /rnal 'byor ri khrod 'grims pa la/ /jag rkun chom pos ting 'dzin 'phrog /bstan dgras ser mo yongs la 'tshe/ /de la nag sbyor zlog dmigs dgos/ / ༈ glo bur dgra byung gnyan sar 'gro /khros mar bskyed cing gos phud nas/ / nang du sngags sbyin dngos su bsam/ /sde brgyad bsdus la gnas por bstim/ / gos kyis gnas po'i mgo la rdeg /gos nang dgra bo'i sha khrag rnams/ /gnas por bstims nas zhe sdang 'bar/ /dgra la dmag sna drangs nas brlag /des ni 'joms par the tshom med/ / ༈ dgra khyim than gyis 'gengs 'dod na/ /shog bu khru gang gru bzhi la/ / dkyil du lhas byin mi gzugs bris/ /tha ma than gzugs gang shes bris/ / bskyed bstims mang byas dngos su bsam/ /rang nyid khros ma'i 'og tu ni/ / chos 'byung bris la nang du bcug /chos 'byung dgra yul dngos su bsam/ /zung ldan bzhi yi bla rdo skyur/ /drag spyod bya zhing dgra bo dang*/ /lha 'dre grangs med mnan par bsam/ /'khrugs nas dgra pham 'dar ba la/ /shes gtad phaṭa kyis brtul zhugs bya/ /bha ling nya bo zor du 'phang*/ /dmigs pa drag po zhal las shes/ / ༈ dgra bo klu la gtad 'dod na/ /ling ga bris la mdze khrag byugs/ /gnyan sa'i 'og tu zhag gsum bting*/ /dbang sdud drag pos rang lus sbyin/ /ti pa tsa dang kha sbyor bya/ /nub phyogs 'byung po'i kha ru bcug /dmigs pa 'jug lugs zhal la dris/ / ༈ dgra yul thog gis bshig 'dod na/ /rang nyid khros ma'i mdun dag tu/ / dgra bo'i khang khyim rnam pa zhig /nang du ling ga ming yig bcug /bskyed bstims byas nas dngos su bsam/

/steng du raṃ dmar yung 'bru tsam/ /je cher song bas dgu ru mched/ /dgra bo'i yul bcas thal bar btang*/ /zhag gsum gnyan sar dmigs pa gzir/ /de nas ling ga 'phang nas su/ /byang phyogs 'byung po'i kha ru gtad/ /mtha' gtad dmigs pas 'byung po gzir/ /thog zor 'phang zhing dmod bcol bya/ /steng 'og dmigs pa rnam gnyis bya/ / ༈ dgra la smyo 'bog gtong 'dod na/ /ling ga dag la smyo khrag byug /dgug gzhug bya zhing mal 'og bcug /snang srid lha 'dre lus la bstim/ /zhag bdun dbang sdud drag po btang*/ /gza' rgod khyab 'jug mig dmar dang*/ /seng zhon stag zhon sdong lha rnams/ /yang yang bstims nas mar me bsad/ /de nas shar phyogs snying gar bcug /dgra bo smyo bar the tshom med/ / ༈ dgra la zha rengs gtong 'dod na/ /ling ga ming yig dag la ni/ /bel rlon lu gu do ma'i khrag / bu+u ga'i rtsa gnas raṃ gyis bskor/ /chu mig lkug pa'i nang du sba/ /steng du klu yi pho brang gdab/ /phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad sbrul ching bya/ /dgra bo zha bar the tshom med/ / ༈ dgra zhing ser bas brlag 'dod na/ /zhing dang yul gyi dbyibs bris la/ / steng du klu bdud btsan gsum gyi/ /bla rdo bzhag nas dngos su bskyed/ /snang srid lha 'dre ma lus bstim/ /zhag gsum lus sbyin dmar 'gyed bya/ /zhing dang yul ming rdo la blan/ /chu mig gnyan po'i nang du sba/ /tsher ma mchu ring btsug pa gces/ khyung dmar chu dbyung dmigs pa bya/ /dgra yul ser bas brlags par bsam/ /dmigs pa sdigs mdzub zhal la dris/ / ༈ dgra la gzer rgod gtong 'dod na/ /phung gsum sa la ru pa bya/ /snying khar ming yig du yod bcug /dgug gzhug bya zhing gan rkyal bzhag /gri khrag skyer phur sna la byug /skyer phur l̥ng ga'i snying gar gzer/ /phur pa gza' bdud rgyal por bsam/ /snang srid lha 'dre de la bstim/ /rang nyid khros mas lha 'dre gzir/ /lha 'dres dgra snying gzir bar bsam/

/rdo sgrom nang du mnan pa bya/ /lus bung chu ni shin tu gces/ / ༈ dgra bo 'on long lkug 'dod na/ /ling ga ming rus bcas pa bri/ / long bar 'dod na mig la raṃ/ /'on par 'dod na rna bar bh+yo/ /lkug par 'dod na kha la nan/ /lha dbye dgug gzhug bskyed bstim bya/ /bya dig khrag dang sbal pa'i khrag /gtso bo khyi thul can gyi khrag /byug nas gnyan khrod gsum du bting*/ /lho phyogs 'byungapo'i mig tu mnan/ /rgya mtsho'i gting bzlog dmigs pa bya/ /rigs rgyud brlag par gdon mi za/ / ༈ dgra bo'i pha tshan 'byed 'dod na/ /ling ga bskor la rgyab sprod bya/ /'ug pa'i khrag dang pho rog khrag /byugs nas gnyan sa'i 'og tu bting*/ /rang phyogs ling ga bya khyung dang*/ /gzhan phyogs dag la sbrul nag bstim/ /gzhan yang lha 'dre ma lus bstims/ /rul spungs 'dam gyi dmigs pa gces/ /de nas rgya gram 'og tu bcug /steng du sde lnga'i bla rdo bya/ /gcer bu phaṭa kyis sa gzhi 'dar/ /dgra bo pha gcig bu gcig 'khon/ / ༈ dgra bo'i rigs rgyud gcod 'dod na/ /ma ni bsen mo dmar mor bskyed/ /steng khang nang du gza' rgod bzhag /ma them sgo ru zla bas brgyan/ /ya them gdung rtsar nyi ma shar/ /nyi zla'i tsha zer 'phros pa yis/ /gza' rgod spun dgu ma gtogs pa'i/ /gzhan gyis skrod par mi nus bsgom/ /mi yi ling ga bris pa yis/ /lte 'og gza' bdud mgo dgu bris/ /mchan khung raṃ dang baṃ gyis brgyan/ /pha ma'i ming yig snying ga 'o/ /phung byed mgo ru rdo rje bsnol/ /dang po pha ma bskyed bstim bya/ /de nas sde brgyad lha 'dre bstim/ /gzir ba'i dmigs pa kha yar bya/ /der ni mgar mdzo'i rwa co bcug /nub phyogs 'byung po'i chu bor mnan/ /rgya mtsho zhabs bzlog dmigs pa bya/ / ༈ byad ma nang 'gras byung ba na/ /gtad khram byas pa'i sa phyogs su/ /gnyan sar phyin la sems bskyed bya/ /ma rig 'khrul pa'i byad mkhan 'di/

/sde brgyad bsgrubs pas bar chad byed/ /mnar med 'gro ba'i pha ma 'di/ kho dang bsrung ma byas pa rnams/ /snying rje drag pos lus sbyin bya/ kho yi bsrung ma'i sems dang ni/ /rang sems gnyis med spros bral bsgom/ /byad ma'i cho 'phrul ci byung yang*/ /snying rje'i shugs phyung skye med bsgom/ /gtor stegs 'og tu nyal bar bsgom/ /des ni tshugs par mi 'gyur ro/ / ༈ dgra bo gsod pa'i dmigs pa ni/ /rang nyid gan rkyal nyal ba ni/ / gshin rje'i gzugs can che bar bskyed/ /brang steng byad ma'i pho brang btab/ / lus sbyin nyi shu rtsa gcig bya/ /de nas pho brang byas pa rnams/ /sum cu rtsa gsum bar du khyer/ kha zhab bzlogs nas sa la brgyab/ /dngos med rdul du brlag par bsam/ /skye med ngang du ma bcos bzhag / ༈ rgya mtsho gting bzlog dmigs pa ni/ /rang nyid khros ma nag mor bskyed/ / dgra bo yul gzhis bcas pa rnams/ /phyag gi mthil du bzhag nas khyer/ /nam mkha'i dbyings nas 'phangs pa yis/ /dbang chen gser la chal gyis brgyab/ / rdul phran tsam du brlags par bsam/ /skye med spros bral ngang la bzhag /de ni ma yengs byas gyur na/ /byad ma brlag par the tshom med/ / ༈ rgya mtsho hub 'debs dmigs pa ni/ /rang nyid bya khyung nag por dmigs/ /snying gar lcags kyi rdo rje bsgom/ /byad ma zhe sdang sbrul du bsam/ / byad ma'i snying gar nṛ zhig dmigs/ /rang nyid ri rab rtse mor bsgom/ /sbrul ni rgya mtsho'i gting nang dmigs/ /rang gi snying ga'i rdo rje de/ /tsha zer ngar ldan song nas su/ kho yi snying kha'i nṛ la brgyab/ /rdul phran tsam du bshig par bsam/ / de nas rang nyid bya khyung gis/ /rgya mtsho hub kyis btab nas btung*/ /byad ma sbrul nag khyu re mid/ /snying rje bsgom zhing smon lam gdab/ /skye med ngang la ma bcos bzhag /nag sbyor 'di dag thams cad la/ /sngon 'gro sems bskyed snying rje bsgom/

/rjes su dmigs pa shin tu gces/ /bsngo ba smon lam rgya yis gdab/ / dri med pas mdzad pa'o/ /dge 'o/ /dge'o/ /dge'o/ / mes po'i shul bzhag las/ klong chen rab 'byams kyi gsung 'bum/ (26)nag sbyor ha la nag po'i dmigs pa bco lnga pa/ - PAGE 290 -- PAGE 289 -- PAGE 285 -
